The perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions, but this doesn't rule out structural artifacts. The Router's texture_anomaly and perspective_distortion observations are plausible, but the severity might be slightly underestimated given the photographic vs. illustrated mismatch and the text issues.
